speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing fatigue and difficulty concentrating, and your blood work is showing some abnormalities. To help me narrow down the cause, have you noticed any unexplained weight loss, fevers, or night sweats recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: The "digital pain that improves with cold" is a classic sign of Raynaud's phenomenon. Given your age, heavy smoking history, and these specific symptoms, are you noticing any skin color changes on your fingers or toes (white/blue/red) when they get cold?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and difficulty to concentrate. I also have Dyspnea on exertion, Dizziness, Digital pain that improves with cold.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Raynaud's Phenomenon associated with Systemic Sclerosis (Scleroderma).
